page.content:
Netherlands playmaker of Total Football at the 1974 World Cup.

How Johan Cruyff connects

  • Concept: Total Football — Cruyff was the playmaker of Total Football at the 1974 World Cup.
  • Event: 1974 FIFA World Cup — Cruyff's Netherlands reached the 1974 World Cup final and lost.

What is Johan Cruyff?

Johan Cruyff never won the World Cup, but his 1974 Netherlands side — Total Football, the Cruyff turn — remains one of the tournament's most quoted losing teams.

Key threads lead to Total Football and 1974 FIFA World Cup.
